superheroes_white_boom.description: Front and side cameras show an empty flat plain and sky at every tick except for one tiny pale speck in the sky at t3. The top camera shows a compact clump of small dirt-textured brown square chunks at ground center at t3, scattered into ~8 widely separated fragments at t8, and nothing at t20.

motion: outward scatter along the ground plane
scale_impression: small - covers a few blocks of terrain

superheroes_white_boom.notes: Visible only from the top camera. Despite the id suggesting a bright blast, the only observable output is dirt-colored debris plus a single faint speck at horizon height; the burst itself is effectively invisible to ground-level cameras.

superheroes_homelander_roar_wave.description: Front and side views show an empty horizon at all five sampled ticks. The top camera shows a tight cluster of dirt-textured brown chunks at t3, a wide scatter of roughly 18 fragments by t4, a few stragglers at t8, and empty grass at t20.

motion: outward scatter along the ground plane
persistence: mostly gone by t8, empty by t20

superheroes_homelander_roar_wave.notes: No wave, ring, or force visual appears in horizontal views; if a shockwave fired it is invisible at eye level. Larger debris spread than superheroes_white_boom but the same lifecycle and texture.

minecraft_flame.description: Front and side views show a small group of 3-5 bright orange-yellow teardrop flame sprites hovering well above the horizon at t3; one or two remain at t8; by t20 only a faint speck survives in the side view. The top camera does not register the flames at all - it shows a single compact brown dirt clump on the ground at t3 that scatters by t8.

persistence: mostly dead by t8, gone by t20
blend_appearance: bright core over sky, additive look

minecraft_flame.notes: Strictly angle-dependent: invisible to the top camera. The sprites float high above the terrain rather than sitting on it.

minecraft_dust.description: A dense cluster of cyan-teal square specks with a brighter core hangs in the sky at t3. By t8 it has split into two looser drifting sub-clouds of mixed-size specks, and at t20 only one or two faint cyan dots remain. The top camera shows a compact dirt clump instead of the dust.

shape: irregular puff of small square specks
density: moderate at t3, sparse by t8
blend_appearance: opaque specks with soft clump edges

possible_roles: (interpretation) colored particle marker for an ability
minecraft_dust.notes: Invisible to the top camera. Specks are larger and more varied in size than typical single-pixel dust, with a brighter core at t3.

levelevent_2001.description: At t3 roughly 25 gray and blue-gray square chunks of varying sizes hang scattered through the air above the plain in both horizontal views, and the top view shows gray squares mixed around a central brown dirt clump. By t8 only a few small gray specks sit low near the ground line, and t20 is empty.

shape: square block fragments of varied sizes
density: dense - highest particle count in the set
persistence: mostly gone by t8, fully gone by t20

levelevent_2001.notes: Largest debris-type effect in the set. The chunks read as actual cube fragments - coarser and more numerous than the fine dirt specks in the other sheets.

vfxlab_ember_ring_burst.description: Horizontal views show a flat ring of small bright orange-red glowing dots floating high above the horizon. The ring reads as a thin ellipse at t2, expands so its dots spread farther apart through t3-t8 (growing beyond the top of the frame), breaks into sparse strays at t15, and is gone by t20. The top camera never shows the ring; it shows a scatter of dirt chunks on the ground instead.

shape: flat horizontal ring of discrete dots
motion: dots thin out on the circumference
scale_impression: large - spans most of the frame width

vfxlab_ember_ring_burst.notes: The ring plane is horizontal - it reads as an ellipse from both ground-level angles. It never appears in the top view, so it is likely emitted above that camera's ground crop; the top frames capture only ground debris.

vfxlab_laser_beam.description: A short thin cyan streak sits at the very top-right corner of the front frame at t3, t8, and t20 with no visible change between ticks; the side view shows only a small cyan dot at a matching height. Almost the whole beam is out of frame - only its tail or cross-section is captured. The top view shows dirt debris at t3 and t8, empty at t20.

motion: static - identical across all sampled ticks

vfxlab_laser_beam.notes: Framing problem: the beam's body sits above the captured area, so its length and travel direction cannot be judged. Zero evolution between ticks suggests a sustained or slowly fading beam.

minecraft_sonic_boom.description: At t3 the front view shows a giant hollow teal ring with a thick double-edged outline spanning most of the frame height and dipping below the horizon line; the side view shows the same event as a solid filled teal disc centered at the horizon. Both vanish completely by t8. The top camera shows only the central dirt clump at t3 and sparse fragments at t8.

motion: single-shot burst - no expansion captured between ticks

minecraft_sonic_boom.notes: Strongly angle-dependent: a hollow torus-like ring head-on vs a filled disc edge-on, consistent with a world-axis-aligned circular billboard or ring mesh. Extremely brief - only the t3 row captures it.

superheroes_scorpion_hellfire.description: All three frames (front view at t1, t2, t4) show an empty flat grass plain under a plain sky - zero particles, glow, or distortion. The sheet contains only front-angle captures; no side or top frames exist.
superheroes_scorpion_hellfire.notes: Front-camera-only sheet covering three early ticks. The effect either failed to spawn, spawned outside the frame, or emits nothing visible at these angles and ticks.
